_comment: What each commit added, in plain words, by commit subject. The list itself is built from git log by scripts/build_site.py (hash, date, subject only; no names or e-mails). Languages without a text fall back to English.

Topics: year -> subject -> topics, sheet.en: Choose year, subject and topics — the sheet is built from the topics you pick.

Safer pull requests: CODEOWNERS, PR safe.en: Every proposed change gets an automatic safety report before it can go live.

Every task carries its id, for exact bug.en: Every task now has an id, so a problem can be reported precisely.
Every task carries its id, for exact bug.uk: Кожне завдання тепер має позначку, щоб точно повідомити про помилку.
